name: What is the process for a home reconfiguration project with Simply Construction?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for a home reconfiguration project with Simply Construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process begins with an initial consultation to understand your vision, needs, and budget. Next, we conduct a site visit to assess feasibility and gather detailed measurements. We then develop a detailed proposal, including design concepts, scope of work, timeline, and cost estimate. Upon approval, we handle all permitting, manage the construction phase with regular communication, and conclude with a final walkthrough to ensure your complete satisfaction.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process involves consultation, site assessment, proposal development, permitting, construction management with regular updates, and a final walkthrough to ensure client satisfaction.
